title: Prompts to Proxies: Emulating Human Preferences via a Compact LLM Ensemble
findings: In a stress test, the P2P framework was trained on general attitudinal and religious-ethical questions. It was found that the learned preference structure could transfer to unseen political-cultural topics, achieving performance comparable to a fine-tuned model despite using significantly less data. This indicates that preferences from religious/ethical domains can be generalized to other domains to some extent.
